commit.message:
Avoid state corruption via bailout

Minimal mitigation for EOL version.

Fix GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w (CVE-2026-109618)
Fix GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp (CVE-2026-109619)

Co-authored-by: Ilija Tovilo <ilija.tovilo@me.com>
